pr_title: xtensa: include core-macros.h on esp32 only
pr_body:
core-macros.h includes other files not part of the xtensa HAL, make this
esp32 specific now until the headers are recovered.

Fixes #31301

comments: This issue not be fixed, it still can be reproduce.

The twister always timeout, because west can not get RIMAGE_CONFIG_PATH **File "/home/ztest/work/zephyrproject/zephyr/scripts/west_commands/sign.py", line 434, in sign
rimage_conf = pathlib.Path(cache['RIMAGE_CONFIG_PATH'])** , this error is in device.log of twister-out. **KeyError: 'RIMAGE_CONFIG_PATH'** .
And rimage can be found in /usr/local/bin/

twister is building test applications for different platforms. In this case it's trying to build (and run) a kernel mutex test application. Which means it isn't building SOF at all. And the `RIMAGE_CONFIG_PATH` variable is cached as a part of the SOF building process. So twister isn't finding it. I'm not sure what the best way to fix the problem would be. If those test applications are indeed supposed to run on the hardware, they have to be signed. For signing rimage needs a toml configuration file and it's located within the modules/audio/sof path. And if you don't build SOF you "don't have access" to that path because we don't want to reach out to files across modules. Maybe the correct solution would be moving rimage to scripts/west_commands/ but rimage is an external project with a sub-project, so, maybe that isn't something that Zephyr will want to do.

review_comments: I would actually say that the xtensa/core-macros.h header is wrong here. The commit, that added it didn't otherwise modify xtensa_api.h. So, either core-macros.h was needed there before and that commit was fixing a bug, or some other file, that includes xtensa_api.h from that commit, now after changes also needs core-macros.h. The former case is impossible, since now if we add that header on Intel ADSP platform build breaks. In the latter case it's those files, that have to include the header explicitly. It seems to me that it's drivers/entropy/entropy_esp32.c that needs it for `XTHAL_GET_CCOUNT()`. I think the core-macros.h header should be removed here and moved to that file.
Yes, correct. `XTHAL_GET_CCOUNT()`is needed. I am checking as well.
fine with me, this was just a workaround anyways to get things building again.
